name: Object-order Binary Volume Projection
aliases: Object-order voxel projection with value-sorted array
definition: An early object-order method for binary volumes where voxels with value one are projected onto the screen in back-to-front order.
summary: Object-order Binary Volume Projection renders binary volumes by projecting voxels back-to-front to resolve occlusion without a Z-buffer, distinguishing itself by restricting input to binary data and relying on traversal order.
